source: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026 (CR26) — Key Security Indicators

ksis.title: Reviewing All Training
ksis.description: The effectiveness of relevant cybersecurity education and training is persistently reviewed, including general training, role-specific training for high risk roles, training for development and engineering staff on secure software delivery, and training for staff involved with incident response or disaster recovery.

ksis.title: Role-Specific Training for Secure Software
ksis.description: Require role-specific training for development and engineering staff covering best practices for delivering secure software.

ksis.title: Logging Changes
ksis.description: Modifications to the cloud service offering are logged and monitored.

ksis.title: Validating Throughout Deployment
ksis.description: Persistent testing and validation of changes throughout deployment is automated.

ksis.title: Reviewing Change Procedures
ksis.description: The effectiveness of documented change management procedures is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Restricting Network Traffic
ksis.description: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately configured to limit inbound and outbound network traffic.

ksis.title: Reviewing Protections
ksis.description: The effectiveness of protection against denial of service attacks and other unwanted activity for machine-based information resources is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Enforcing Intended State
ksis.description: Automated services are used to persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state.

ksis.title: Designing for Compromise
ksis.description: Identity and access management systems are designed to assume resources will be compromised.

ksis.title: Automating Account Management
ksis.description: The lifecycle and privileges of all accounts, roles, and groups are securely managed using automation.

ksis.title: Reviewing Incident Response Procedures
ksis.description: The effectiveness of documented incident response procedures is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Evaluating Configurations
ksis.description: The configuration of machine-based information resources, especially infrastructure as code, is persistently evaluated and tested.

ksis.title: Logging Event Types
ksis.description: A list of information resources and event types that will be logged, monitored, and audited is maintained and persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Authorizing Log Access
ksis.description: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time access authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for access to log data.

ksis.title: Generating Inventories
ksis.description: Authoritative sources are used to automatically generate real-time inventories of all information resources when needed.

ksis.title: Documenting Security Objectives
ksis.description: The security objectives and requirements for each information resource are documented.

ksis.title: Reviewing Security in the SDLC
ksis.description: The effectiveness of building security and privacy considerations into the Software Development Lifecycle and aligning with CISA Secure By Design principles is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Reviewing Investments in Security
ksis.description: The effectiveness of the provider's investments in achieving security goals is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Aligning Backups with Objectives
ksis.description: The alignment of machine-based information resource backups with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Aligning Recovery Plan
ksis.description: The alignment of recovery plans with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

ksis.title: Reviewing Recovery Objectives
ksis.description: The desired Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are defined and persistently reviewed for alignment with the provider's business needs and capabilities.

ksis.title: Testing Recovery Capabilities
ksis.description: The capability to recover from incidents and contingencies aligned with defined recovery objectives is persistently tested.

ksis.title: Evaluating and Improving Security
ksis.description: Information resources are persistently evaluated for opportunities to improve security and those improvements are persistently made.

ksis.title: Securing Information
ksis.description: Information is encrypted or otherwise secured from unwanted access or modification.

ksis.title: Automating Configuration Management
ksis.description: The configuration of machine-based information resources is managed using automation and persistently reviewed for drift.

ksis.title: Validating Resource Integrity
ksis.description: Cryptographic methods are used to validate the integrity of machine-based information resources.

ksis.title: Preventing Residual Risk
ksis.description: Plans, procedures, and the state of information resources are persistently reviewed after making changes to limit and remove unwanted residual elements that would likely negatively affect the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of federal customer data.

ksis.title: Validating Communications
ksis.description: The authenticity and integrity of communications between machine-based information resources is persistently validated using automation.

ksis.title: Removing Unwanted Data
ksis.description: Unwanted federal customer data is removed promptly when requested by an agency in alignment with customer agreements, including from backups if appropriate.

ksis.title: Mitigating Supply Chain Risk
ksis.description: Persistently identify, review, and mitigate potential supply chain risks.

ksis.title: Monitoring Supply Chain Risk
ksis.description: Third party software information resources are automatically monitored for upstream vulnerabilities using mechanisms that may include contractual notification requirements or active monitoring services.
